items.notes: Explicit re-review releases only the historical provenance/rank hold for Sesame purée. The committed retained-evidence subset for this exact target contains USDA Foundation FDC 2262073 'Sesame butter, creamy' at observed rank 6, matching the historical FDC ID, description and data type. The hold itself records no food mismatch; it exists because the historical review recorded rank 4 while the retained snapshot shows rank 6. This approval reconciles that provenance discrepancy without changing the selected nutrient record, creating a substitution rule, or authorizing reuse for other foods; confidence is medium because purée/butter naming and product formulation can vary.

Explicit re-review releases only the historical provenance hold for Almond purée. The retained source candidate is USDA Foundation 'Almond butter, creamy' under another almond-cream target, proving the exact FDC row in immutable evidence even though the held destination was excluded from candidate re-search. Almond purée and plain creamy almond butter are treated as the same ground-almond food family for a bounded nutrition reference, but the record does not certify brand, added oil, sugar, salt, roast level, water content, cultivar, or processing details; confidence is medium. Nutrition remains the USDA per-100-g almond-butter reference with no serving or recipe conversion inferred. The original hold row and historical review remain unchanged for audit.
